fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published the findings report of the fifth Gambia Labour Force Survey, GLFS 2026 (Q1), a 157-page report disseminated in the second half of July 2026; the document gives no release date, so the published date 2026-07-30 is used.

The Standard reports that the Gambia Bureau of Statistics presented the findings of the 2026 Q1 Gambia Labour Force Survey, the fifth, at a national workshop (labour force 781,868; unemployment 6.2%); the story is dated 2026-07-30 and gives no separate release date.

The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published a report comparing its labour force survey across three rounds, 2023 Q1, 2025 Q1 and 2026 Q1; the document gives no release date, so the 2026-07-30 retrieval date stands in, and it was disseminated at a national workshop in the second half of July 2026.
